testCaseRef.description: Reference to another test scenario as a step. IMPORTANT: Use relatedId, NOT caseId.

relatedId.description: Test scenario ID to reference (get from test-scenario list)

script.description: Script execution step. IMPORTANT: parameters must contain type="customScript", data (code), enable=true. Do NOT use language or code fields.

delay.description: Delay step - pauses execution. IMPORTANT: Use parameters.timeout (milliseconds), NOT duration.

group.description: Container for grouped steps. Group display name belongs in parameters.name, NOT top-level name. REQUIRED: disable=false, parameters={ name? }, isOpen=true, children=[].

parameters.description: Group parameters. Use parameters.name for the group display name. Do NOT use top-level name.

name.description: Group display name shown in the scenario step tree

if.description: Conditional branch. IMPORTANT: Use keyVariable/operator/valueVariable format, NOT expression. REQUIRED: disable, parameters, isOpen=true, children=[].

children.description: Steps to execute when condition is true

else.description: Else branch for if step. REQUIRED: disable=false, parameters={} (MUST be empty object), isOpen=true, children=[].

children.description: Steps to execute when if condition is false

loop.description: Loop iteration step. REQUIRED: disable=false, parameters.count, isOpen=true, children=[].

children.description: Steps to execute on each iteration

forEach.description: For-each iteration over array. IMPORTANT: Use array field (JSON string), NOT source or itemName. REQUIRED: disable=false, parameters.array, isOpen=true, children=[].

children.description: Steps to execute for each array item

break.description: Break out of loop/forEach. Can be unconditional or conditional with parameters (keyVariable/operator/valueVariable).

onError.description: Error handling branch. REQUIRED: disable=false, parameters={}, isOpen=true, children=[].

httpManualFromApi.description: Recommended default for importing an API definition as an HTTP step. Provide bindType="API", syncMode="MANUAL" (or omit syncMode), and httpApiCase.apiDetailId/projectId. CLI expands path, method, parameters, requestBody, auth, settings, and processors from the API definition; the step is then manually maintained unless the user syncs it.

bindId.description: API endpoint ID. CLI can fill this from httpApiCase.apiDetailId when omitted.

httpApiCase.description: Minimal API-bound case payload. Full request structure is generated by CLI.

httpAutoSyncWithApi.description: Advanced mode for importing an API definition as an HTTP step and keeping it automatically synced with the API definition. Use only when automatic sync is intended; this is not the default import behavior.

bindId.description: API endpoint ID. CLI can fill this from httpApiCase.apiDetailId when omitted.

httpApiCase.description: Minimal API-bound case payload. CLI generates the request structure while preserving automatic-sync semantics.

httpManual.description: Manual HTTP step. The request content is maintained by the user and is not automatically synced with the API definition, so complete httpApiCase fields are required.

httpTestCase.description: HTTP step bound to test case. Set bind=true, bindType="TEST_CASE", syncMode="SYNC_WITH_TEST_CASE", httpApiCase.type="TEST_CASE".

customHttp.description: Standalone custom HTTP request. IMPORTANT: Use path field for URL, NOT url. Required: customHttpRequest with id=0, path, method, projectId.

path.description: Full URL (e.g. https://api.example.com) - IMPORTANT: use path, not url

database.description: Database execution step. Execute SQL queries against configured database connections.

connectionId.description: Database connection ID from project settings
